responsibility: Provides the compiler’s reusable logging initialization crate for rustc-style tracing outside of `rustc_driver`. Its root file, `compiler/rustc_log/src/lib.rs`, serves as the standalone entry point: it gathers logger-related environment configuration into a shared settings structure, installs the global tracing subscriber with rustc’s hierarchical formatting and filtering behavior, optionally enables target-specific backtrace reporting, and exposes the configuration error types and terminal-detection helpers needed by external tools, debugging binaries, and other compiler-adjacent code. Overall, this crate contributes the standard way to bootstrap rustc-compatible diagnostics and tracing output in contexts that need compiler logging behavior without depending on the full driver.
